Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick answers:
- Backstage passes: We can allocate up to 6 backstage passes per primary sponsor + 2 staff load-in credentials for the booth crew. Sponsor VIP passes are limited and intended for on-stage/greenroom access.
- Sponsor badges: Sponsor badges do not automatically grant backstage access; you must provide a list of names for backstage authorization and we will issue temporary backstage wristbands at check-in.
- Arrival/load-in: Crew credentials will be valid for two consecutive hours during the scheduled load-in window (Saturday 06:00–10:00 local).

Please send the list of backstage names in the next 48 hours. Also note: power drops at Island D3 are on the east side; if you need an additional 20A circuit we'll need that request on the PO to build into the floorplan.

Best,
Alex Moretti
Operations Manager, Apex Expo
expo_ops@apexexpo.com
